The '''ExOne series''' was designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Issan Len]] to control complex technological systems like [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The prototype, [[X0-X1]], was created and attempted to take over [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
